verdict.rationale: First-party Workspace docs list voicemail-to-text transcription as a core Voice feature. Hands-on community reports confirm transcribed voicemails are emailed to the user's inbox, call it a 'killer feature', and praise Spanish transcription; one user notes occasional transcription failures require opening the app, which affects reliability, not whether the feature exists. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of email delivery and its configuration, any evidence of delivery to chat channels, and documented transcription accuracy or failure handling.
